Reversing the whole string with `dt[::-1]` doesn't work. For "2026-01-02" it gives "20-10-6202", because it reverses the digits inside each part as well as the order of the parts. So I'm keeping my earlier approach: split on "-" and reorder the parts.

```python
def change_date_format(dt):
    y, m, d = dt.split("-")
    return f"{d}-{m}-{y}"
```
